fact: BCPFS and ONECI signed a convention on 2 April 2026 to interconnect the RSU with ONECI databases and the RNPP for unique identification of beneficiaries and removal of duplicates.

Cote d'Ivoire is operationalising its Registre Social Unique, a single registry of poor and vulnerable households to be shared with social programmes for targeting, with more than 200,000 households in the process of registration through the SIG-RSU system (BCP Filets Sociaux).

fact: A 7-11 September 2025 workshop at Grand-Bassam, run by the Ministry of National Cohesion through the Filets Sociaux programme office, aims to update the Registre Social Unique's interoperability framework for data sharing between SIG-RSU and CNAM, CNPS, CGRAE, ONECI, WURI and DOB.
